comment: The statement that two valid FHIR systems can diverge in meaning is correct, but alignment to the same logical model alone is not sufficient. Systems must also share terminology versions, invariants, extensions, workflow expectations, and exchange behaviour.

anchor.note: p.96 l.Lines 318-321 read as the printed page; section 4.3.3 agrees

public.text: The statement that two valid FHIR systems can diverge in meaning is correct, but alignment to the same logical model alone is not sufficient. Systems must also share terminology versions, invariants, extensions, workflow expectations, and exchange behaviour.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand the conditions for semantic interoperability and conformance accordingly.
